solver_stabilization.rationale: Controlled DPT/adaptive ablations (local://tier4_convergence_rootcause.md) identify the missing drain output capacitance as the primary, sufficient cause of Tier-4 solver timeouts: with only the ideal switch, clamp diode and inductor there is no bounded state variable at the near-step dV/dt, so LTspice never reaches t_end. One measured linear C_QOSS using the vendor Curve-4 Coss at cap_ref_Vds makes every previously failing arm complete; it slows drain dV/dt and adds L-C overshoot. The measured Vgs=0 off-state Roff removes a secondary, vendor-specific 1e12 singularity but is not a common fix. Solver stabilization only.

source.rule: measured small-signal Coss at the Curve-4 cap_ref_Vds reference; solver-stabilizing linear C only, not a voltage-dependent/waveform-fidelity model

c_qoss.note: Measured linear output capacitance used only as a bounded drain-node state variable for the solver.

r_off.note: Measured Vgs=0 DC-sweep off-state resistance used in SW_T4 when finite; otherwise the emitter falls back to the project-decision Roff with a loud comment and this disclosure.

solver_stabilization.disclosure: C_QOSS is a single measured linear output capacitance (curve4.coss_f at cap_ref_Vds), added only to keep the drain node bounded and let the solver reach t_end; it is NOT a voltage-dependent charge model and no waveform fidelity is claimed. It slows drain dV/dt and adds L-C overshoot. The DPT waveform gate remains retired_by_design; dv/dt, ringing and Miller droop stay retired/unclaimed. Voltage-dependent capacitors and the body diode remain retired; loss tables remain comment-only metadata.
